metadata.comment: ReserveAccountBalance REFUSED -> InsufficientBalance (ADR-PC-016 slot 5: the constitution debit is gated on funds). Higher-priority mapping; fires when the request body contains the marker 'insufficient', letting a dev/demo drive the saga fail-closed compensation toward DepositConstitutionFailed without a second stub. The dispatcher classifies this 422 (a 4xx) as a TERMINAL delivery failure it surfaces to the saga (ADR-PC-029 slot 5).
